title: RAW UNREVIEWED: full-entry rival sources for an f9v reading
summary: Select two independently identified, dated entries for different but visually plausible plants before reading f9v. Freeze each entry's distinctive relationships and absences, including a source's own naming usage. Require a proposed complete f9v reading to favor one entire source profile over the other; a shared flower or generic use alone is non-discriminating. Source availability and fit remain unchecked.

design.unit: two fixed external entries and one complete f9v reading
design.contrast: pansy-like source profile versus independently selected visual rival profile
design.prediction: a reading favors one whole profile by source-owned relations and explicit absences, not interchangeable terms
